description: 78s sales call with positive engagement. Sales rep (A) and customer (B). Human-reviewed.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Good afternoon, thanks for taking the time today.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Just to confirm, you wanted to understand

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: how our platform could help streamline

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: your reporting workflow, right?

segments.speaker: B
segments.text: Yes, exactly.

segments.speaker: B
segments.text: We're spending a lot of manual time consolidating data

segments.speaker: B
segments.text: from different teams and it's becoming a bottleneck.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: That makes sense.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: What most of our customers do is centralize

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: those inputs into one dashboard.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: So instead of chasing updates,

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: everything is visible in real time.

segments.speaker: B
segments.text: That sounds useful.

segments.speaker: B
segments.text: How long does the setup usually take?

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Typically around one week for an issue of setup

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: and another week for team onboarding.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: No heavy technical work from your side.

segments.speaker: B
segments.text: Okay, and pricing-wise, how does it work?

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: It's a subscription model based on the number of users.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: For a team of your size,

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: it would be around 35,000 rupees per month.

segments.speaker: B
segments.text: That's within our budget.

segments.speaker: B
segments.text: I'll need to check internally, but it seems reasonable.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Great.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: What I can do is send you a proposal

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: and a short demo recording today.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: If it looks good, we can aim to start next week.

segments.speaker: B
segments.text: Yes, please do that.

segments.speaker: B
segments.text: I'll review it by Friday.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Perfect.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: I'll follow up on Friday afternoon then.
